notes:
Inbound SMB lead — developer-first SaaS (B2B helpdesk). Came in through self-serve signup, using hosted API sandbox. Primary ask: choose an economical model family for chat+embeddings for a support assistant.

Key customer constraints / quotes:
- "We want tight latency for chat (target ~200-300ms p95) but can't pay top-tier pricing — cost sensitivity high."
- "Embeddings must be fast and affordable for nightly reindexing (thousands docs) — prefer ~100ms per request on hosted."
- Multi-model routing interest: cheaper base model for standard queries + higher-quality model for escalations.

Technical details discussed:
- Workload: primarily chat assistant (conversational + retrieval augmented), embeddings for semantic search, small amount of reranking for search results. Expected qps: 3-10 sustained, spikes to ~50 during peak support hours.
- Latency targets: chat p95 <= 300ms; embeddings <= 120ms preferred. Cost sensitivity: wants to keep monthly inference spend < $5k while scaling.
- Model families under consideration: Llama variants (llama2-7b/13b instruct), Mistral (mistral-medium / mistral-large), Qwen 7b/14b chat. Interested in tradeoffs between quantized 4-bit variants (cost) vs fp16 (quality).
- Customer asked specifically about:
  * token-level pricing differences between model families on Hosted API, and how quantized variants change cost and latency;
  * expected p95 token latency for small vs medium models at their qps;
  * guidance on mixing models via routing policies (latency-tiered fallback) and how Redwood handles model pinning for deterministic behavior.
- Other ops/security needs: SOC2 compliance proof doc requested, SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs for production traffic. Data residency not strict — public cloud ok.

Notes from call (shorthand):
- Eng: cares about KV cache / prompt length impact on latency. Will likely keep context <= 4096 tokens.
- PM: cost is gating — wants clear cost estimates per 1M tokens for candidate models.
- Wants a short PoC: run hosted_api with 2 model configs for 2 weeks, measure latency/cost/quality on a representative prompt set.

Suggested Redwood playbook for next steps (agreed on call):
1) SE (Daniel) to run quick perf estimate: p95 token latency and approximate cost for llama2-7b, mistral-medium, qwen-7b quantized 4-bit and fp16 on hosted. Share ballpark $/1M token numbers.
2) Send hosted pricing + model-comparison one-pager (including quantization caveats, expected quality delta). Link to examples.
3) Enable 14-day PoC credits and spin up 2 model routes: cheap-default (quantized 4-bit mistral-medium or llama2-7b-q8), high-quality fallback (fp16 qwen-14b or llama2-13b-instruct). Add simple routing policy based on latency budget and fallback thresholds.
4) 30-min technical call week of 2026-03-15 to finalize prompts, eval prompts + setup metrics to compare quality (ROUGE/semantic eval) and cost.

POC success criteria (customer-proposed):
- Chat p95 <= 300ms with default route for 80% of traffic.
- Embedding cost < $0.01 per request (ballpark) and batch throughput sufficient for nightly reindex.
- Quality: human-rated pass rate >= 85% on a 50-sample eval set for critical intents.
